gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: mature 20d durability across cash, same-theme, and broad benchmarks may identify Space trend continuation candidates worth incremental default-off risk.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260514-041 accepted 10d benchmark-breadth trend risk at 1.025x.
exp-20260514-036 rejected fast 5d confirmation because it had no runtime signal coverage.
exp-20260514-033 rejected a 10d benchmark-breadth delayed substitute with no changed runtime signals.
No prior experiment tested a mature 20d durability state across same-theme and broad benchmarks.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the 20d durability trend scalar changes; no entry, exit, ranking, target, LLM/news, ticker pool, or live-slot change.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: Same three Space windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed windows, max DD damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 trades, and nonzero changed 20d durability signals.

hypothesis: Space official catalysts whose 20d closed event-state profile is still positive versus cash, same-theme replacement, SPY, QQQ, UFO, and ARKX may deserve an extra conservative trend allocation because durability should be a stronger continuation state than the accepted 10d benchmark-breadth signal.
known_risks: Space remains default-off; this does not authorize live Space slots.
The 20d mature sample may be too sparse for acceptance even if the profile is directionally interesting.
next_evidence_needed: Needs more mature 20d closed Space forward rows or a different production-visible catalyst-quality field.

locked_variables: all accepted Space scalars through exp041

rejection_reason: The 20d durable replacement trend state did not clear Gate 4 versus the accepted exp041 stack. Do not retry this exact 20d durability cohort without more mature closed forward rows.
single_causal_variable: extra trend_long risk scalar for the mature 20d durability profile; the accepted exp041 Space stack stays fixed
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited, nearby 10d benchmark-breadth and delayed-absorption scalar retunes are anti-repeat families, and broad ticker expansion has repeatedly failed. This run tests a new closed-forward maturity horizon instead.
